description: Runs the pre-send audit on a campaign and returns the findings (brand kit, banned phrases/phishing, links, Liquid personalization, consent rules). It only reports; it does not change, approve or send the campaign. Critical findings block sending until someone acknowledges them in the dashboard. Required scope: notifications:write or mcp:write.

app_id.description: App ID (app_…). Not needed with an app-scoped key or when a default app is configured.

check_links.description: true: also fetches the links in the content to verify them (slower).

name: run_campaign_preflight
title: Campaign pre-send check
